satellite_rules.effect: While the window is active the red satellite detects all alive and visible 24000 interceptor entities and shares those tracks with the whole red team; high-speed platforms (21000) get hit rate 1.0 against 9400/9600 during the window.
satellite_rules.command: A satellite request is issued by any one red platform via the satellite_request action; each accepted request consumes one team use and opens/re-opens the shared window.

map_rules.note: Red platforms are already deployed; deployment positions are listed per platform below and cannot be changed.

weapon_rules.satellite_hit_bonus: While the satellite window is active, 21000 hit rate against 9400 and 9600 becomes 1.0.
weapon_rules.multi_hit_modifier: For 21000/21001 attacking 9400 only: if another 21000/21001 hit the same target within the configured interval and the impact angle difference exceeds the configured minimum angle, the hit rate is multiplied by (1 + up to the configured max increase), decaying linearly with the time gap; similarly, near-simultaneous hits arriving at nearly the same angle multiply the hit rate by (1 - up to the configured max decrease).

multi_hit_parameters.increase_interval_minutes: see satellite_and_hit_rules in the battle state
multi_hit_parameters.decrease_interval_minutes: see satellite_and_hit_rules in the battle state

weapon_rules.detection_sharing: Red platforms within mutual communication range share and fuse their detections per step; the satellite shares its detections with the whole team while active.

scoring_rules.formula: final score (0..100) = 100 * sum(objective weight * damage fraction of that objective's initial health) / sum(objective weights); damage fraction is clipped to [0, 1] per objective.
